cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import json, random
rng = random.Random(7)
n = 48
links = []
poss = [(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n)]
rng.shuffle(poss)
links = poss[:128]
caps = [rng.randint(1, 100) for _ in links]
parts = rng.sample(range(n), 32)
r = {v: rng.randint(1, 10**6) for v in parts}
env = [[l, rng.randint(1,100)] for l in range(128)]
req = {'op':'load','n':n,'links':[[u,v,c] for (u,v),c in zip(links,caps)],'bookings':[]}
reqs = [req, {'op':'prepare','id':'P1','owner':'o','window':[0,10**6],'period':10**6,
   'participants':[[v,r[v]] for v in parts],'envelope':env,'rev':0}]
open('big.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(json.dumps(x) for x in reqs)+'\n')
print('written')
" && time (python3 -I -B /workspace/submission/main.py < big.jsonl | head -c 400; echo)
